response.sql: WITH execution_counts AS (SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) as exec_count FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), total_executions AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM orderexecutions), execution_shares AS (SELECT ec.ordersmark, ec.exec_count, ec.exec_count::float / te.total as share, AVG(ec.exec_count::float / te.total) OVER () as avg_share FROM execution_counts ec CROSS JOIN total_executions te) SELECT ordersmark, exec_count, share, share - avg_share as share_diff FROM execution_shares ORDER BY ordersmark IS NULL, share_diff DESC LIMIT 10;
